t: For an additional amount for “Board of Parole”, $3,125.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that the word "Board" signals an advisory body with outside members. That fails because the section only appropriates additional funds to the Board of Parole, a federal entity, and sets out no consultation, hearing, comment period, rulemaking, or right to sue. No party outside the federal government is brought into any federal decision.
fable.s: For an additional amount for “Board of Parole”, $3,125.

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation of funds to a government entity (the Board of Parole). It does not establish any process for consulting with or coordinating with parties outside the federal government, nor does it create advisory bodies with non-federal members or grant rights to the public. It is purely a budgetary provision.
qwen_block.s: For an additional amount for “Board of Parole”, $3,125.
